item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.7

  • Links in notes: an address you type or paste now reads as one, and a click opens it. Hold any key while clicking to put the caret inside it instead
  • The deck's dots sit at the exact middle of the screen edge, and the notes come out level with them — a single note no longer appears up at the top
  • Smaller text: notes can now be set to 14, 12 or 10 pt as well as the larger sizes (Settings › General › Text size)
  • A new typeface, Inconsolata — the open face drawn after Consolas (Settings › General › Handwriting)
